doctrine: Envelope measures reduce load and should be sequenced ahead of HVAC plant sizing decisions wherever the capital timeline allows it
Piggyback on planned capital events: roof insulation goes in at re-roof, not as a standalone tear-off; window film precedes full window replacement as the boring-proven, low-cost first move
Air sealing is the highest ROI, lowest-disruption envelope measure and should be checked before any insulation or glazing spend

Measured savings from envelope work show up as reduced HVAC run-hours and heating/cooling degree-day-normalized usage — credit modeled savings only provisionally until a post-install billing cycle confirms them
Maintainability: avoid exotic facade systems that require specialty subcontractors not available in the local market; prefer standard assemblies the property's roofing/GC vendor already services
Name tenant disruption honestly: roof and exterior air sealing are typically none/light; full window replacement is in-unit and can be vacancy-required for occupied-unit scheduling at scale

Air sealing changes combustion air dynamics: before tightening any building with atmospheric-vented gas appliances, require combustion-safety testing (backdraft/CO spillage) and remediate or convert to sealed-combustion — a safety gate, not an economics one
origination_prompts: Does the PCA flag the roof as approaching end-of-life or already scheduled for replacement? Insulation-at-re-roof candidate.
Are there visible signs of air infiltration (audit blower-door results, high heating/cooling load relative to peer buildings) suggesting an air-sealing pass?
Are windows single-pane or original-to-construction with no planned replacement capital? Window film is the low-cost interim step.
Does the audit note uninsulated or under-insulated attic/roof deck assemblies?
feasibility_checks: Confirm re-roof timing and scope with property management/ownership before proposing insulation-at-re-roof — this is a capital-event-dependent measure, not standalone
Check historic/facade restrictions (landmark districts, HOA rules) that could block window or cladding changes
Verify window film's compatibility with existing glazing (tempered glass, warranty voiding) before spec'ing it
Check Shovels for local roofing and glazing contractor permit activity as a market-capacity signal
Name tenant disruption class per measure: roof/air-sealing work is none/light; window replacement scheduling is in-unit and may need vacancy-required treatment for full-building rollouts
data_requirements: roof age, condition, and remaining useful life from PCA
capital plan / re-roof schedule if one exists
Combustion appliance inventory (venting type) for any air-sealing scope
